name: ButtonDock
description: Bottom action dock for the React Native mobile app, matching the DS StickyButton set — single/double/triple/ghost button stacks, optional checkbox accessory row, optional slot content (e.g. a price summary), sticky page-bottom float.
notes: Dropped vs. web: the 'IOS controls: Keyboard' mock (prototype-only chrome — a real RN app gets the actual system keyboard), and primaryIconLeft/primaryIconRight/loading/destructive/success (app-ds's own Button doesn't support these yet). Backdrop blur approximated with a flat AlphaWhite40 tint.
